channel.description: SpaceX's supersized Starship launches into orbit for the first time but flight ends early

item.title: Alex Eala 'didn't take lightly' decision to play Asian Games over China Open
item.description: Alex Eala is prioritizing representing the Philippines at the Asian Games over the WTA Tour for the moment

item.title: US targets Iran's military supply chain as the status of diplomatic talks remains uncertain
item.description: The U.S. has targeted people and firms around the globe that it has accused of being financial facilitators or enablers of Iran’s military supply chain

item.title: FACT FOCUS: The poverty rate is at an all-time low, but there are other factors to consider
item.description: President Donald Trump claimed that the U.S. has the “best poverty numbers in history,” meaning less poverty now than at any other time

item.title: Inflation cooled slightly last month even as consumers stepped up spending
item.description: Inflation slowed a bit last month as Americans ramped up their spending, though price gains remained elevated and are a challenge for many voters as the midterm elections approach

item.title: Congress votes to end production of the penny after 234 years, sending a bill to Trump
item.description: Legislation passed by the Senate and headed to President Donald Trump’s desk will formally end the production of pennies after 234 years

item.title: Smart ring maker Oura puts off initial public offering due to market 'uncertainty'
item.description: Smart ring maker Oura says it is postponing a planned initial public offering due to market “uncertainty.”

item.title: Right Livelihood Award honors women taking on autocrats, discrimination and unchecked AI
item.description: The Right Livelihood Award has been given to two women and two women-led organizations to recognize work against authoritarianism, violence and AI-related harms

item.title: Trump says top tech firms have signed accord to 'self-police' AI development
item.description: President Donald Trump says that he and a large group of leaders of artificial intelligence companies had signed a voluntary accord that will include internal and external reviews of the technology during a meeting at the White House

item.title: Altman unveils 'always-on' AI agent after OpenAI shelves model over safety concerns
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has introduced a new AI agent called Dot, described as “remarkably capable, always-on.”

item.title: Dutch police arrest a suspected ShinyHunters member; court orders 90-day detention
item.description: Dutch police have arrested a suspected member of the ShinyHunters hacker group, linked to major data breaches

item.title: North Korea denies planting mines that injured 3 South Korean soldiers, accuses Seoul of conspiracy
item.description: The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has rejected South Korean findings that North Korea planted the land mines that injured three South Korean soldiers last week

item.title: Carney accuses US steelmaker of betraying Canadian workers after layoffs tied to Trump tariffs
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney accused the U.S. owner of steelmaker Stelco of betraying Canadian workers after it announced layoffs it attributed in part to U.S. President Donald Trump’s tariffs — tariffs Cleveland-Cliffs’ chief executive has publicly championed

item.title: Russia pounds the Kyiv region with missiles and drones, killing 4 and targeting the power grid
item.description: Russia pressed its missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and surrounding areas, killing four people, including a child

item.title: South Korea embraces a huge shark slowly circling a canal in the country's biggest port city
item.description: A huge gray shark named Bukangi has become an honorary mascot in South Korea’s biggest port city

item.title: SpaceX's supersized Starship launches into orbit for the first time but flight ends early
item.description: SpaceX has launched its enormous Starship into orbit for the first time and successfully delivered the newest and most advanced Starlinks yet
